exposure: Use of newborn's 24-hour weight for weight loss calculation
use of newborn's 24-hour weight (24HW) as preferred reference for weight loss calculation
cohort: 667 healthy full-term newborns delivered by C-section
finding: Routine use of the newborn's 24-hour weight as the reference for weight loss calculation reduced supplementation rates without increasing adverse effects during the hospital stay.
mod_finding: This study investigated the effect of using a 24-hour weight on supplementation rates in newborns delivered by C-section but did not specifically examine differences in outcomes based on mode of delivery.
